To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the proposed framework can be applied to any time series forecasting task, that the proposed framework outperforms the benchmark methods, and that the proposed framework has a high potential for real-life time series forecasting applications.

1) the LSTM and GRU models perform similarly well in terms of accuracy; 2) the LSTM and the GRU models outperform the benchmark models; and 3) the LSTM and/or GRU models can be used for forecasting in a variety of domains and for a variety of tasks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How to forecast a time series using a recurrent neural network?
the following questions: How to improve the performance of time series forecasting?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
RNNs are good for time series forecasting.
recurrent neural networks are not yet a panacea for time series forecasting.
the LSTM network outperforms the GRU network in terms of accuracy and the GRU network outperforms LSTM in terms of computational speed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
RNNs are not as good as ARIMA and other time series models for forecasting, but they are good at feature extraction.
the recurrent neural network approach can be used for forecasting, but the results depend heavily on the feature engineering.
recurrent neural networks can be successfully used for time series forecasting, but they require a lot of care and attention to details.
The main takeaway from our work is that
recurrent networks are not a silver bullet for time series forecasting.
the LSTM and GRU models are not as good at forecasting as the ARIMA model.
recurrent neural networks can be used for time series forecasting with good results.
